summary: The diff implements Object.groupBy and its GroupBy abstract operation (property coercion only) in group_by.rs, touching nothing else. I walked the spec steps in order. RequireObjectCoercible and the IsCallable TypeError come first, then GetIterator. The 2^53-1 check closes the iterator with a TypeError. IteratorStepValue propagates errors with ?. The callback is called with (value, k) and this=undefined. Abrupt key results and ToPropertyKey failures go through IfAbruptCloseIterator. Groups keep first-seen order via a separate Vec of keys. Each result object is built with OrdinaryObjectCreate(null), CreateArrayFromList and CreateDataPropertyOrThrow. Step comments are kept in place. I found no special-casing, hardcoded values, swallowed abrupt completions, or made-up returns. The gate's 24 newly passing test262 tests fit a diff of this size.
